integrity: Analytical argument independently reconstructed using the finite Walnut formula and direct-integral diagonalization. Exact-rational checker is finite corroboration, not a proof of the continuum assertion. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the signed Haar window, rectangular area-one-half lattices and 1<b<=2. It establishes exact spectral bands, optimal bounds and completeness, but does not classify all lattices or assert that arbitrary earlier general Gabor spectral results are excluded.
title: Exact spectral bands and abrupt completeness boundary for Haar Gabor systems
